edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W gold card for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Death Mark: 120s at rank 1 — spend Zhonya's or gold card AFTER the dash lands, never before. - Living Shadow: 20s early — with W down Zed cannot poke-swap or escape; that is your trade window. - Your yellow card returns every 6s.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Death Mark pops 3 seconds after he dashes in — stun him first, then stasis: a late Zhonya's eats the detonation itself.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: With yellow spent, Living Shadow (20s early) finds you on the plate — give up the gold and hold position the 6 seconds until Pick a Card is back.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit: stacked-deck autos and card cycling answer his Q-E poke — whoever lands the read takes the level.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Even farming levels — Q the wave, hold yellow for his W commit, and trade only in W downtime.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: Late it evens: your AoE and global pressure in 5v5s offset his solo picks — split R-safe or hold Destiny to collapse.
